vocabulary.definition: a person who lives alone and apart from society
vocabulary.example: The old man who lived in the cabin by the lake was known as a hermit.

vocabulary.definition: a person who lives alone and avoids contact with others
vocabulary.example: The famous writer became a recluse after achieving great success.

vocabulary.definition: a short statement expressing wise advice or a general truth
vocabulary.example: One of his famous dictums is 'Actions speak louder than words.'

vocabulary.definition: to reject the normal ways of society and live outside the system
vocabulary.example: After years of feeling stifled in the corporate world, she decided to drop out and pursue her passion for art.

vocabulary.definition: the state of being alone or isolated
vocabulary.example: She found solace in the solitude of the mountains, away from the noise of the city.

vocabulary.definition: a reward or gift of something special and enjoyable
vocabulary.example: As a treat for acing her exams, her parents surprised her with a trip to her favorite theme park.
